resources.string: Game Boy Advance, Game Boy Color & Game Boy
Select a legally obtained .gba, .gbc, or .gb ROM file from your device using Android\'s system file picker. No games or BIOS files are bundled with this app.
Battery saves (SRAM) are stored in app-private storage and are removed by Android if you uninstall this app. Use Export Save to keep external backups.
Running with mGBA\'s built-in HLE BIOS fallback (no proprietary BIOS required for standard playback). Optional user-supplied BIOS selection is planned for a future milestone.
